_meta.method: 4-agent web research (dimension-per-agent), relative calibration, each agent scored all 7 tools on its axis with a cited source per cell
_meta.scope: toolScores only (49 cells). roleWeights (60) + scoreWeights (3) NOT calibrated here — separate editorial pass.
_meta.status: PROPOSAL — pending owner review. Promote into scoring-model.json toolScores only after approval (stop-and-confirm, like price changes).
_meta.note: Research largely confirmed the hand-set baseline (most cells within +/-0.05). Biggest evidence-based shifts: automatisch.selfHost 1.00->0.80 (younger, fewer install paths), node-red.noCode 0.10->0.20, make.aiNodes 0.70->0.78 (native AI Agents app).
